post_title: Laid off right after H1B lottery picked
concerns_or_questions_summary: User was working at a late-stage startup on F-1 OPT when their H-1B lottery was picked on March 30; two weeks later they were terminated for performance reasons. With about a year of OPT left, one remaining lottery chance and roughly 75 days to find a new sponsoring employer, they are asking for advice and support on the job search and visa situation.
